strongest_combination.reference_A: US8672871B2 - CSF pressure sensing implantable with wireless communication
strongest_combination.reference_B: US10307577B2 - CSF venous pressure differential shunt with dual pressure sensor
strongest_combination.motivation: The combination of a wireless CSF pressure sensing implantable and a CSF venous pressure differential shunt with dual pressure sensor would provide a convenient and accurate way to monitor CSF pressure and predict shunt occlusion.

rationale: The combination of US8672871B2 and US10307577B2 would be obvious to a person of ordinary skill in the art because it would be a straightforward combination of existing technologies. The wireless CSF pressure sensing implantable would provide a convenient way to monitor CSF pressure, and the CSF venous pressure differential shunt with dual pressure sensor would provide accurate predictions of shunt occlusion. The combination would be a functional interaction, as the two components would work together to provide a new technical effect, namely, the ability to monitor CSF pressure and predict shunt occlusion in a convenient and accurate way.
